added_failures_note: derived from gate-base.log and gate-head.log directly: both arms report 4 passed and no FAILED id, so the run added none; the manifest's own baseline_suite/after_suite values are not parseable JSON and the standard reader returned None for both

findings.text: blocking: the composer column is headed n=174 but its per-slot accuracy is computed over the 48 edit targets whose pre-rename spelling parses canonically, and 126 of the 174 composers do not parse and are silently dropped by run.py:398-407, so the composer comparator the brief required "on the same sources" is reported over a subset 0.27x the stated size.

follow-on: the resume guard "slot_match" in pr[0] is unreachable because every write routes through _write_results (run.py:443-454), which strips slot_match along with the other derived fields, so no file the driver writes can satisfy it and a cut-short run re-pays for all 434 rows rather than resuming.

follow-on: the fragment asserts every figure is a metric function from imas_codex/discovery/base/evaluation.py and the driver adds none of its own, but exact-name match, per-slot accuracy, family agreement and composer agreement are computed by driver-local helpers at run.py:275-344, which evaluation.py does not own.

follow-on: the done_when requires the figure styled with plt.style.use("data-ink"), but the committed driver contains no plotting code, so the figure is not reproducible from the landed artefacts and the styling requirement cannot be verified from them.

follow-on: baseline_suite and after_suite are written as inline objects with unquoted keys, which reckon.crew.review._gate_log_path cannot parse, so it returns None for both arms and the run's added-failure count is unmeasurable from its own manifest; the count here was derived by reading gate-base.log and gate-head.log directly.

item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is a measurement fragment for plan section 2; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-segment-selection-measure.html:33-131 reports exact-name match, per-slot accuracy, family agreement, the composer's figures, cost per name, the disagreement AUC with its bootstrap interval, and the recommendation by the plan's fixed rule.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states complete and names the two gate logs and the two revisions, but its baseline_suite and after_suite values are inline pseudo-objects the standard reader cannot parse, so its suite records cannot be reduced by the reader.

justifications.durability: the node adds no test and declares no negative control, and tests/standard_names/test_segment_selection.py exercises the unchanged module, so nothing reddens if the driver's metric code regresses.
